description: This file is a shell script used for testing reftable backend consistency in a Git environment. It sets up repositories, manipulates reftable tables, and verifies their integrity, including handling error conditions and edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs the provided commands, and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test, such as removing temporary directories.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with a given message.
